An update regarding electronic report cards and the parent document repository was on the meeting agenda.
studentParentImpact: The Upper Canada District School Board scheduled a review of its proposed budget for the 2025-26 school year, which impacts funding for classroom resources and school staffing. Trustees were also set to look at updates regarding electronic report cards and an online parent document system, which affects how families access student grades and official updates. Additionally, a land purchase in Cornwall and a draft four-year strategic plan were listed for trustee consideration. Because this agenda describes a past scheduled meeting, no immediate action or input is requested from parents or students in the provided agenda text.
policyChanges: Draft Policy 314 regarding electronic trustee meetings was on the agenda, along with proposed updates to Policy 4002 on facility collaboration and Policy 414 on asset disposal. Trustees were also set to review Procedure 311.1 covering the board member code of conduct.
